from __future__ import annotations

@dataclass
class Ctx:
    pages: list[str]
    triage: dict
    notes: dict
    probes: Probes
    now: float
    decisions: dict[str, dict]
    ledger: dict[str, list[dict]]
    answered: list  # wi_fields.AnswerRec
    acted: set[str]
    issue_prio: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    html: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    previews: dict = field(default_factory=dict)  # item id -> live preview url
    number_repos: dict[str, set[str]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    tasks: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    spawns: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

def build(
    now: float | None = None,
    budget_calls: int = GH_BUDGET,
    probes: Probes | None = None,
) -> dict:
    now = now or time.time()
    C.CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    probes = probes or Probes(C.CACHE, budget_calls, now)
    spawns = {
        d["slug"]: d for d in read_jsonl(C.O / "logs" / "spawns.jsonl") if "slug" in d
    }
    tk = tasks()
    runs = child_runs(spawns, now)
    ledger = read_jsonl(C.O / "ledger.jsonl")
    led: dict[str, dict] = {}
    by_slug: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for r in ledger:
        led[r.get("slug")] = r
        by_slug.setdefault(r.get("slug"), []).append(r)
    decisions = read_json(C.O / "decisions.json", [])
    triage = {
        (short_repo(t["repo"]), t["number"]): t
        for t in read_json(C.O / "scratch" / "issues-triage.json", [])
    }
    all_prs = list(
        {
            (p["repository"]["name"], p["number"]): p
            for p in [*fetch_prs(probes), *H.fetch_proposals(probes),
                      *card_sources(probes, [p[0] for p in R.PROJECTS])]
        }.values()
    )
    ordinary_tasks = {s: t for s, t in tk.items() if not H.RUN_RE.fullmatch(s)}
    asm = Assembly(spawns, led, [p for p in all_prs if not H.is_proposal(p)], probes)
    asm.register_producers(ordinary_tasks)
    revs = reviews()
    asm.add_prs(revs)
    asm.add_tasks(ordinary_tasks, runs, now)
    asm.add_decisions(decisions)
    asm.add_queue(read_json(C.O / "queue.json", []))
    asm.add_triage(triage)
    ctx = Ctx(
        pages=sorted(
            p.name
            for p in (C.O / "pages").glob("*.html")
            if p.name not in ("dashboard.html", "dashboard-classic.html", "index.html")
        ),
        triage=triage,
        notes=read_json(C.O / "workitems-notes.json", {}),
        probes=probes,
        now=now,
        decisions={str(d.get("id")): d for d in decisions if isinstance(d, dict)},
        ledger=by_slug,
        answered=answer_records(C.O / "answers"),
        acted=acted_ids(C.O / "actions"),
        issue_prio=issue_priorities(probes),
        previews=live_previews(C.O),
        tasks=tk,
        spawns=spawns,
    )
    ctx.notes = collapse(asm, ctx.notes, tk)
    if "--migrate-notes" in sys.argv:
        result = migrate_notes(
            C.O,
            {iid: it["_note_aliases"] for iid, it in asm.items.items()},
            {iid: it["children"] for iid, it in asm.items.items()},
        )
        print("notes migration:", json.dumps(result))
        latest = read_json(C.O / "workitems-notes.json", {})
        ctx.notes = dict(latest)
        for iid, it in asm.items.items():
            ctx.notes[iid] = (
                effective_note(latest, it["_note_aliases"], iid, it["children"])
                if it.get("_deduped")
                else latest.get(iid, {})
            )
            it["_ask_overrides"] = ctx.notes.get(iid, {}).get("ask_overrides", [])
    # Keep health proposals out of ordinary dedupe; each repo owns its whole nightly history.
    asm.pr_by.update(
        {
            (short_repo(p["repository"]["name"]), p["number"]): p
            for p in all_prs
            if H.is_proposal(p)
        }
    )
    ctx.notes = H.attach(asm, tk, runs, ctx.notes)
    for it in asm.items.values():
        repo = short_repo(it["repo"] or "")
        for ref in (it["issue"], it["pr"]):
            if ref and repo:
                ctx.number_repos.setdefault(str(ref["number"]), set()).add(repo)
    for iid, it in asm.items.items():
        finish(it, iid, ctx)
        H.finish_health(it, asm, revs)
    releases = R.snapshot(list(asm.items.values()), probes, now)
    R.reconcile(list(asm.items.values()), releases)
    for it in asm.items.values():
        it["release_operation"] = R.is_release_item(it)
    attach_taken(asm.items, runs, spawns)
    probes.save()
    ordered = sorted(
        (i for i in asm.items.values() if not i.pop("hidden")),
        key=lambda x: x["updated"],
        reverse=True,
    )
    return {
        "generated": iso(now),
        "releases": releases,
        "statuses": STATUSES,
        "items": ordered,
        "children": sorted(
            (
                {k: v for k, v in c.items() if k != "final"}
                | {"goal": tk.get(s, {}).get("goal", "")}
                for s, c in runs.items()
            ),
            key=lambda c: c["start"],
            reverse=True,
        ),
        "ledger": ledger,
        "decisions": decisions,
        "host": host(),
        "gh_calls_left": probes.budget,
        "probe_calls": dict(probes.calls),
    }

def identify(it: dict, iid: str, repo: str, ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    """Title, kind and branch from the sources, before any curated text."""
    if it["issue"]:
        t = issue_title(repo, it["issue"]["number"], ctx.triage, ctx.probes)
        it["title"] = it["title"] or t
    it["title"] = (
        it["title"] or (it["pr"] or {}).get("title", "") or it.get("goal", iid)
    )
    if not it["kind"]:
        it["kind"] = kind_of(iid, it["title"])
    elif iid.startswith("issue-") and it["kind"] in (
        "issue",
        "feature",
        "test",
        "docs",
        "fix",
    ):
        it["kind"] = kind_of("issue-x", it["title"])
    if not it["branch"] and it["slugs"]:
        s = [x for x in it["slugs"] if not x.endswith(("-fix", "-review"))]
        it["branch"] = f"auto/{s[0]}" if s and it["pr"] else ""

def finish(it: dict, iid: str, ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    note = ctx.notes.get(iid) or {}
    ch = sorted(it['children'], key=lambda c: c['start'])
    card = next((c['card'] for c in reversed(ch) if c.get('card')), {})
    rows = [r for slug in it['slugs'] for r in ctx.ledger.get(slug, [])]
    it['repos'] = wi_repos.derive(it, card, note, ctx.tasks, ctx.spawns, rows)
    if not (it.get('pr') or it.get('issue')):
        it['repo'] = it['repos'][0]
    repo = REPOS.get(it['repo'], it['repo'])
    identify(it, iid, repo, ctx)
    match_pages(it, iid, repo, ctx.pages, number_repos=ctx.number_repos, html=ctx.html)
    ch = sorted(it['children'], key=lambda c: c['start'])
    running = any((c['running'] for c in ch))
    if ch:
        active = [c for c in ch if c['running']]
        it['child'] = {k: (active or ch)[-1][k] for k in ('slug', 'tool', 'model', 'duration', 'cost', 'running')}
    outcomes = it.get('outcomes', [])
    it['evidence'] = ' · '.join((clip(o.get('gates') or '', 200) for o in outcomes if o.get('gates')))
    res = compute(it, outcomes, ctx.probes)
    it['status'] = res['status']
    heuristic_text(it, outcomes)
    card = next((c['card'] for c in reversed(ch) if c.get('card')), {})
    it['raw_title'] = it['title']
    it['steps'] = steps_of(note, card)
    it['work_provenance'] = resolve_work_provenance(note, [ctx.tasks[s] for s in it.get('slugs', []) if s in ctx.tasks], card)
    curated, preview = curate(it, note, card)
    preview = preview or ctx.previews.get(iid, '')
    if 'needs' in curated:
        settle(it, res, it['needs'])
    override = None if running else note_status(note.get('status'), res['status'])
    if ch and (not running) and (override == 'Doing'):
        override = None
    if it.get('_deduped') and res['status'] in ('Integration', 'Main', 'Deployed') and override:
        if override == 'Dropped' or STATUSES.index(override) < STATUSES.index(res['status']):
            override = None
    it['status'] = override or res['status']
    if note.get('status') in ASKING_OLD and (not running):
        res['asking'] = True
    if isinstance(note.get('blocked'), str):
        res['blocked'] = clip(note['blocked'], 160)
    it['blocked'] = res['blocked']
    it['dropped'] = drop_reason(res, note, it['needs']) if it['status'] == 'Dropped' else ''
    it['stage'] = res['stage']
    it['repo'] = it['repo'] or 'orchestra'
    it['hidden'] = bool(note.get('hide'))
    ask_note = note if 'health' in it else merged_asks(it, note, card)
    res['asking'] = fill_text(it, curated, res['asking'], ask_note, note.get('status') in ASKING_OLD, [ctx.tasks[s] for s in it.get('slugs', []) if s in ctx.tasks])
    it['ui'] = ui_of(it, note)
    it['gates'] = gates_of(it, preview, note, ctx.probes, ctx.html)
    asks(it, ask_note, curated, res['asking'], ctx)
    if it['ask'] and note.get('ask') and (res['done'] == 'Deployed') and (not (running or override or it['pr'])):
        it['status'] = 'Backlog'
    it['links'] = links_of(it)
    led_rows = [r for s in it['slugs'] for r in ctx.ledger.get(s, [])]
    attach_refs(it, note, it.pop('_reftext', []) + [f"{r.get('note') or ''} {r.get('gates') or ''}" for r in led_rows])
    it['agent'], it['reviewer'] = (agent_of(ch), reviewer_of(it))
    it['history'] = history_of(it, led_rows)
    for c in it['children']:
        c.pop('card', None)
    it.pop('goal', None)
    it['cost'] = round(sum((c['cost'] or 0 for c in it['children'])), 2)
    it['priority'], it['priority_src'] = priority_of(it, note, ctx.issue_prio)
    it['order'] = order_of(note)
    it['proposals'] = [p for p in note.get('proposals') or [] if isinstance(p, dict)][-5:]
    it.pop('_deduped', None)
    it.pop('_ask_overrides', None)
    it.pop('_note_aliases', None)

def heuristic_text(it: dict, outcomes: list[dict]) -> None:
    tri = it.get("triage") or {}
    it["problem"] = clip(it["title"], 200)
    if tri.get("why"):
        it["problem"] += " — " + clip(tri["why"], 200)
    last_gates = outcomes[-1].get("gates") if outcomes else ""
    it["solution"] = clip((it["pr"] or {}).get("title", "") or last_gates or "", 240)
    it["needs"] = needs_of(it)

def asks(it: dict, note: dict, curated: set[str], asking: bool, ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    """Your call: notes ask > decisions > needs; a curated "Niente…" answers every question."""
    it["ask"] = ask_of(it, note.get("ask"))
    raw_asks = note.get("ask")
    raw_asks = [raw_asks] if isinstance(raw_asks, dict) else raw_asks
    raw_asks = [a for a in raw_asks if isinstance(a, dict)] if raw_asks else raw_asks
    for a, raw in zip(it["ask"], raw_asks or it["ask"]):
        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            a["_item"] = raw.get("_item", it["id"])
            a["_answered"] = raw.get("_answered", False)
    if (
        "needs" in curated
        and is_nothing(it["needs"])
        and not (it.get("_deduped") and note.get("ask"))
    ):
        it["ask"] = []
    elif asking and not it["ask"] and "ask" not in note:
        it["ask"] = [split_advice({"link": ask_link(it)}, it["needs"])]
    for a in it["ask"]:
        a["question"] = a["question"] or it["needs"]
        a["rec"] = a["rec"] or NO_REC
    enrich_asks(it, ctx.decisions, ctx.answered)
    # answered on the dashboard (answer file or dispatch/comment action): out of Your call until a new ask appears
    for a in it["ask"]:
        if "health" not in it and (
            a.get("_item", it["id"]) in ctx.acted or card_ids(it) & ctx.acted
        ):
            a["answered"] = True
    open_asks = [a for a in it["ask"] if not a["answered"]]
    # closed by Orchestra in the notes (released or dropped): its old questions are moot
    if ctx.notes.get(it["id"], {}).get("status") in ("Deployed", "Dropped"):
        open_asks = []
    it["your_call"] = bool(open_asks)
    it["call_kind"] = (open_asks or it["ask"] or [{"kind": ""}])[0]["kind"]
    # an item whose only open work is its checklist is a "Da fare tu"; open questions come first
    if it.get("steps") and not open_asks:
        it["call_kind"] = "action"
    it["serve_te"] = it["your_call"]
def enrich_asks(it: dict, decisions: dict[str, dict], answers: list[AnswerRec]) -> None:
    """Final kind, decisions.json questions and answered flag on every ask."""
    mine = owned(it, answers)
    for a in it["ask"]:
        d = decisions.get(a["id"]) if a["id"] else None
        a["kind"] = ask_kind(a, it, d)
        qs = (d or {}).get("questions")
        a["questions"] = qs if isinstance(qs, list) else []
        # an ask without id is answered under the item id (the modal posts decision=<item id>)
        a["answered"] = bool(a.get("_answered") or ask_answered(a, it, mine))

def qualified_pr(raw: object, repo: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if (
        not isinstance(raw, dict)
        or type(raw.get("number")) is not int
        or raw["number"] < 1
    ):
        return None
    url = raw.get("url")
    if not isinstance(url, str):
        return None
    try:
        parsed = urlsplit(url)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if (
        parsed.scheme != "https"
        or parsed.netloc not in ("github.com", "git.adlimen.dev")
        or parsed.query
        or parsed.fragment
    ):
        return None
    match = re.fullmatch(r"/([\w.-]+)/([\w.-]+)/(pull|pulls)/(\d+)/?", parsed.path)
    if (
        not match
        or int(match[4]) != raw["number"]
        or f"{match[1]}/{match[2]}" != repository_authority(repo)
    ):
        return None
    if match[3] != ("pull" if parsed.netloc == "github.com" else "pulls"):
        return None
    repository = f"{match[1]}/{match[2]}"
    if ("host" in raw and raw["host"] != parsed.netloc) or (
        "repo" in raw and raw["repo"] != repository
    ):
        return None
    return {
        "host": parsed.netloc,
        "repo": repository,
        "number": raw["number"],
        "url": url,
    }
